# qovery_git_token (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about an existing Qovery git token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "qovery_git_token" "my_git_token" {
  id              = "<git_token_id>"
  organization_id = "<organization_id>"
}

# Access the git token's attributes
# data.qovery_git_token.my_git_token.name
# data.qovery_git_token.my_git_token.type
# data.qovery_git_token.my_git_token.description
#
# The token value itself is never returned by the Qovery API:
# data.qovery_git_token.my_git_token.token is always null.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Id of the git token.
- `organization_id` (String) Id of the organization the git token belongs to.

### Optional

- `bitbucket_workspace` (String) Bitbucket workspace where the token has permissions. Only set when `type` is `BITBUCKET`.
- `description` (String) Description of the git token.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the git token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Value of the git token. The Qovery API never returns it, so this attribute is always `null` when read through the data source.
- `type` (String) Type of the git token.
	- Can be: `BITBUCKET`, `GITHUB`, `GITLAB`.
